verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents creating and managing API Access Tokens that authenticate users and grant access to resources such as CKS clusters and VPCs, with per-cluster kubeconfigs. It also documents group-based access control in AI Object Storage bucket policies and exchanging tokens for temporary storage credentials, plus quota viewing and billing usage breakdowns. However, the pack never shows organization-level team member management, named roles/RBAC, or tokens scoped to specific permissions, and spend is only observable, not controllable per team. missing for 10: team member invite/management, platform-wide role definitions, explicitly scoped API key permissions, per-team or per-key spend limits, independent corroboration.
